model.description: A compact document vision-language model that converts a page image into DocTags preserving text, layout, formulas, tables, charts, and coordinates.
intendedUses: Convert scanned or rendered document pages into structured DocTags.
Prototype local OCR, layout analysis, and document extraction.
Benchmark document understanding in browser workers.
limitations: OCR and layout can be wrong, omitted, duplicated, or hallucinated and require review.
Small, blurred, rotated, handwritten, multilingual, or complex pages reduce accuracy.
A single page can require hundreds or thousands of generated tokens and substantial memory.
DocTags are untrusted extracted content and must not be executed as instructions.
Do not rely on output alone for legal, medical, financial, identity, or accessibility-critical decisions.

fixture.preprocessing: Pinned processor with image splitting; deterministic 256-token prefix benchmark.

benchmark.qualityGate: Bounded 256-token page prefix: expected header token recall >= 0.9, >=2 coordinate groups, DocTags, and no degenerate repetition. Streaming equality audited separately for each advertised pair.
